nodes.label: Tonal Elevation (not shadows)
nodes.rationale: Depth is communicated via surface container tone; shadows only for busy backgrounds or overlapping elements.

nodes.label: Key Differences from MD2
nodes.rationale: Tonal surfaces replace shadows, dynamic color from one seed, fully rounded corners, spring motion, and 3 contrast levels.

nodes.label: Compose-first Material Android (I/O 2026)
nodes.rationale: New Android Material 3 work should default to Jetpack Compose Material3 for latest components, expressive APIs and adaptive scaffolds; Views only for legacy apps.

nodes.label: Canonical Layouts
nodes.rationale: Always start from a canonical layout (feed, list-detail, supporting pane) rather than a raw grid.

nodes.label: Foldable Postures (tabletop, book)
nodes.rationale: Never place interactive or critical content across the hinge.

nodes.label: 8dp Spacing System
nodes.rationale: Spacing tokens for margins, padding and gaps allow layouts to adapt programmatically to device type and density.

nodes.label: MD3 Principles (Personal, Adaptive, Expressive)
nodes.rationale: MD3 aims to be personal (dynamic color), adaptive (5 window size classes) and expressive (shape morphing, springs, emphasized type) without sacrificing usability.

nodes.rationale: Renaming visible text that is also an object key must rename dependent keys or fail, else images/counts/assets break.

nodes.label: Entry Atomicity
nodes.rationale: An entry is applied only when every op lands; failed entries are undone so no partial source edits remain.
